differential.name: Diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Presence of type 2 diabetes with microalbuminuria and proteinuria points to diabetic kidney disease as the primary driver of CKD.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Documented anemia in the setting of CKD and reduced erythropoietin production is typical.

differential.name: Metabolic acidosis secondary to chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Low serum CO₂ (20.4 mmol/L) with normal anion gap suggests renal tubular acid retention common in CKD.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Co‑existing hypertension and progressive CKD are consistent with hypertensive renal injury contributing to renal decline.
